# 📚 Tech Stack Reference & Interview Preparation Guide

👋 Welcome to the knowledge base! This resource is designed to assist both human learners and AI assistants in preparing for advanced technical interviews by providing comprehensive documentation across multiple domains.

## 🚀 Technologies Covered

This repository contains deep-dive documentation for the following key technologies and concepts:

*   **💻 Frontend & Web:**
    *   [JavaScript](/javascript/README.md): The fundamentals and advanced concepts.
    *   [React.js](/reactjs/README.md): Building modern, component-based UIs.
    *   [Next.js](/nextjs/README.md): Advanced web frameworks with SSR and SSG.
*   **🐘 Backend & Data:**
    *   [Node.js](/nodejs/README.md): Server-side JavaScript runtime expertise.
    *   [Java](/java/README.md): Core Java concepts and advanced topics.
    *   [SpringBoot](/springboot/README.md): Enterprise-grade Java back-end development.
*   **💾 Databases:**
    *   [MongoDB](/mongodb/README.md): NoSQL database concepts and advanced queries.
    *   [MySQL](/mysql/README.md): Relational database design and stored procedures.
*   **🧩 Design & Architecture:**
    *   [LLD](/LLD/README.md): Low-Level Design (LLD), behavioral, creational, and structural patterns.
